title: Wiemer photo hotspots (v2)
description: A full-bleed photo band (115% of the window tall on desktop, 2:3 on phones) with small white round “+” buttons pinned to details. Each grows and turns 45° on hover and opens a small card with a close-up and a few words; the photo drifts slowly as you scroll. Without hotspots it is a plain parallax photo band.
notes: hotspot cards use the native popover attribute: no JavaScript, light-dismiss and Esc built in
place hotspots in % of the photo; on phones the 2:3 crop moves things, so check positions there
height "photo" gives a 3:2 band (the contact page uses it without hotspots)
name: wiemer-v2-hotspots

props.name: media
props.description: the full-bleed photo (an ), cropped to fill; a soft placeholder when empty

props.name: label
props.description: for screen readers: what the photo shows

props.name: hotspots
props.description: the round "+" buttons on the photo; leave empty for a plain photo band

props.name: height
props.description: how tall it is from lg: "window" = 115% of the window, "photo" = a 3:2 frame (phones are 2:3)

props.name: drift
props.description: let the photo drift inside the band as you scroll (default on)

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the detail card's close button
